Description:
I am reporting an ongoing, extremely loud industrial noise nuisance coming from the concrete plant on Raleigh Street in Charlotte.  The noise began at approximately 9:00 PM on August 14, 2026 and has continued for more than four hours into the early morning of August 15, 2026.  I can directly see the source of the activity from my residence. Two workers are working behind/around a pickup truck next to the concrete mixer trucks and appear to be operating equipment or machinery that is producing extremely loud, repetitive industrial noise. The sound is clearly audible from inside my residence and has continued throughout the night.  I have attached video evidence showing the workers, equipment, concrete trucks and location while the noise is occurring.  I am requesting that CMPD investigate this as an active nighttime noise nuisance and determine whether the activity violates Charlotte’s Noise Ordinance, including the nighttime restrictions applicable to machinery and other unreasonably loud activity.  The activity is occurring now and has been ongoing continuously since approximately 9:00 PM.  Please document this complaint and investigate the active noise source.
